# Investopedia

> > Investopedia is the world's leading source of financial content on the web, providing comprehensive education on investing, personal finance, economics, and market analysis.

Investopedia offers expert-written articles, definitions, calculators, and guides covering topics from high-yield savings accounts and monetary policy to technical analysis and retirement planning. The site features reviews of financial products from major institutions including Capital One, Marcus, E*TRADE, and Wells Fargo, alongside real-time market commentary on events affecting the S&P 500 and global economies.

## Key Topics

- Interest rates and APY
- High-yield savings accounts
- Monetary policy and inflation control
- Technical analysis and market volatility
- Personal finance and banking
- S&P 500 and Wall Street markets
- Economic policy
- Retirement accounts and Social Security
- IPOs and underwriting
- Corporate bankruptcy and liquidation
- Geopolitical risk and investments
- Gold and Bitcoin as assets
- Defense and military budgets
- Estate planning and trusts
- Financial institutions (Capital One, Marcus, E*TRADE, Wells Fargo, Discover)

## Personal Finance & Banking

- [High-Yield Savings Accounts: Boost Your Savings](https://www.investopedia.com/articles/pf/09/high-yield-savings-account.asp): Guide to high-yield savings accounts featuring Capital One, Marcus, Discover
- [Calculate Loan Costs and Payments With Our Loan Calculator](https://www.investopedia.com/loan-calculator-5104934): Interactive tool for calculating monthly payments and total loan costs
- [Could Your Social Security Payments Be Garnished Due to Unpaid Debts? What To Know First](https://www.investopedia.com/could-your-social-security-payments-be-garnished-due-to-unpaid-debts-what-to-know-first-11923351): Explains when Social Security benefits can be garnished for debts
- [Naming a Trust as Beneficiary of a Retirement Account: Pros and Cons](https://www.investopedia.com/ask/answers/09/trust-beneficiaries.asp): Estate planning guide for naming trusts as retirement account beneficiaries

## Economics & Monetary Policy

- [How Governments Fight Inflation With Monetary Policies](https://www.investopedia.com/ask/answers/111314/what-methods-can-government-use-control-inflation.asp): Explains government monetary policy tools for controlling inflation
- [Accounting vs. Economics: Key Distinctions Explained](https://www.investopedia.com/ask/answers/032315/what-difference-between-accounting-and-economics.asp): Compares accounting (GAAP/IFRS) and economics disciplines and careers
- [U.S. vs. China Military Spending: Which Is Bigger?](https://www.investopedia.com/articles/personal-finance/043015/us-vs-china-military-budget.asp): Analysis comparing U.S. ($997B) and China ($314B) military spending in 2024

## Investing & Markets

- [Best Online Stock Trading Classes for March 2026](https://www.investopedia.com/the-best-online-stock-trading-classes-8773769): Reviews top trading courses from Warrior Trading, Udemy, and others
- [Why Do Gold Prices Plummet? Supply, Demand, and Economic Impact](https://www.investopedia.com/articles/investing/071414/when-and-why-do-gold-prices-plummet.asp): Analyzes factors causing gold price drops including supply-demand dynamics
- [Understanding Underwriters: Their Role in IPOs](https://www.investopedia.com/ask/answers/041415/what-does-underwriter-do-new-stock-offering.asp): Explains underwriter functions in IPO pricing and SEC approval process
- [Guess What Asset Has Performed Well During the War in Iran? Believe It or Not—It's Bitcoin](https://www.investopedia.com/guess-what-asset-has-performed-well-during-the-war-in-iran-believe-it-or-not-it-s-bitcoin-btc-gold-11925133): Bitcoin outperforms gold and S&P 500 during Iran conflict geopolitical risk
- [Mortgage Rates Hit a 3-Year Low—Then Came the Iran Conflict](https://www.investopedia.com/mortgage-rates-hit-a-3-year-low-then-came-the-iran-conflict-11922239): Mortgage rates drop below 6% then reverse due to Iran geopolitical tensions

## Corporate Finance & Business

- [Liquidation Priority: Secured vs. Unsecured Creditors](https://www.investopedia.com/ask/answers/09/corporate-liquidation-unpaid-taxes-wages.asp): Explains creditor hierarchy and payment order during corporate bankruptcy

## Financial Terms & Definitions

- [Exchange Membership Explained: Definition and Functions](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/m/member.asp): Defines exchange membership rights for trading on stock exchanges
- [Demand Index Explained: How It Guides Trading Decisions](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/d/demand-index.asp): Technical indicator definition measuring buying/selling pressure via volume
- [What Does "At a Premium" Mean? Definition and Impact](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/a/at-a-premium.asp): Financial term definition for assets priced above intrinsic value
